repair.scope: Only CHM members with one of the four existing recognized legacy HTML PUBLIC declarations.
repair.operation: Use the existing bounded inert preview parser to identify an unmatched closing p while body is open. Insert its missing empty start-p token, preserve all source characters and then reparse through unchanged extract_document.
repair.untouched: The general HTML reader and its malformed end-tag policy, source/member/runtime identities, stage budgets, no-clobber publication, active/hidden-content omission and unverified quotation status.
repair.provenance: Original member SHA256 and normalized parser-input SHA256 are both retained. A specific normalization warning is recorded.
repair.qualification: .chm remains NOT_QUALIFIED until actual successor native source and installed populations pass.

primary_references.relevance: The end-p rule inserts a missing p element before closing when no p is in button scope. The adapter applies only its narrower body-open/no-open-p case and preserves its other stricter nesting requirements.

The standard parser's callbacks distinguish raw-text script/style content from actual end-tag tokens. The CHM normalizer uses these existing callbacks and refuses non-simple closing-p token spellings.
